description: Membership Tier System - Add tier-based benefits on top of existing voting and username systems

userStories.title: Define tier constants and types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need shared tier definitions so both API and web can determine user tiers consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Create apps/api/src/lib/tiers.ts with Tier enum (Free, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond)
Export TIER_THRESHOLDS: { Free: 0, Bronze: 1, Silver: 5, Gold: 15, Diamond: 50 }
Export VOTES_PER_DAY: { Free: 1, Bronze: 3, Silver: 7, Gold: 15, Diamond: 25 }
Export FEE_DISCOUNTS: { Free: 0, Bronze: 0.25, Silver: 0.5, Gold: 0.75, Diamond: 1 }

userStories.title: Define base fee constants
userStories.description: As a developer, I need fee constants for all tool operations to calculate tier discounts.
acceptanceCriteria: Biblio: { send: 0.002, burnNft: 0.002, burnFt: 0.0002, cleanup: 0.0002, basicLock: 0.05, secureLock: 0.1 }
Export getFeeForOperation(operation: string, tier: Tier): number function
Diamond tier returns 0 for all operations

userStories.title: Add /user/tier API endpoint
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need to fetch the current user's tier to display benefits.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch user's staked Dandies count from existing staking infrastructure
Return: { tier, stakedCount, votesPerDay, feeDiscount, hasVanityAccess: tier >= Gold }

userStories.title: Update VotingDO to use tier-based vote limits
userStories.description: As a system, I need vote limits based on user tier instead of hardcoded 3.
acceptanceCriteria: Update VotingDO.vote() in apps/api/src/dos/voting.ts to accept maxVotes parameter
Update VotingDO.getRemainingVotes() to accept maxVotes parameter
Update showcase.ts vote endpoint to get user's tier and pass correct maxVotes
Update showcase.ts /votes/remaining endpoint to return tier-based limit

userStories.title: Update username gating from lock to tier
userStories.description: As a Gold+ member, I want to claim a username based on my tier not just locking.
acceptanceCriteria: Change requirement from 'locked Dandy' to 'tier >= Gold (15+ staked)'
Return 403 with error 'Requires Gold tier (15+ staked Dandies)' if tier too low
Keep existing username validation and claiming logic

userStories.title: Create TierBadge component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see tier badges that visually distinguish membership levels.
acceptanceCriteria: Diamond: cyan with subtle shimmer effect

userStories.title: Add tier store and fetch hook
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need to fetch and cache the user's tier info.
acceptanceCriteria: Add tier atoms to apps/web/src/stores/showcase.ts or create apps/web/src/stores/tier.ts
Add tierAtom with shape: { tier, stakedCount, votesPerDay, feeDiscount, hasVanityAccess } | null
Export Tier enum for use in components

userStories.title: Display tier badge on showcase page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my tier badge on the showcase page.
acceptanceCriteria: Display TierBadge next to username in both editor and public view
Badge shows on leaderboard entries based on dandyCount
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Update vote display to show tier-based limits
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my tier-based vote limit not hardcoded 3.

Update remainingVotesAtom response type to include maxVotes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
